purpose: Verified background records for the round-4 automated-driving positioning (Sec. I, Sec. X-A) and the Table I rebuild. They are not yet cited. build_data.py and verify_delivery.py read only background-verification.json, which requires every bibliography entry to be cited, so a record moves there unchanged in the commit that first cites it.
citation_scope: All staged records are dated 2021-2026, so the seven pre-2021 foundational exceptions of data/citation-scope.json are unchanged.

standards_decision.question: How to cite standards without a DOI. The repository had no precedent: every background record was an opened Crossref DOI record and refs.bib held no standard entry.
standards_decision.sae_j3016: Not a no-DOI case: Crossref holds 10.4271/j3016_202104 (type standard), cited through the Crossref pattern as B_DrivingAutomation2021.
standards_decision.iso_21448: User decision A: cite ISO 21448:2022 as an IEEEtran @standard entry that carries only fields shown on the official ISO catalogue page (reference number, title, organization ISO, year 2022, catalogue URL) and no DOI. The background record has the new type official-catalogue-page with the URL, the retrieval date and the SHA-256 of the saved page. The saved page stays in the gitignored revision/local/ and is never committed.
standards_decision.rendering: IEEEtran prints organization, "Std." and number, so the bibliography number is the reference number without its organization prefix: the entry reads "ISO Std. 21448:2022" rather than "ISO Std. ISO 21448:2022".

moved.note: All five staged records moved unchanged to background-verification.json in the commit that first cites them (round 4, Sections I and X).
